subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should this PR continue as the focused fix for the Feishu latest-token final-chunk bug, and what proof path should satisfy the real-behavior gate?
rationale: The contributor cannot provide a live Feishu/CardKit capture, the PR is assigned to a maintainer, and merging safely requires a human choice between contributor proof, maintainer-run validation, or folding the work into broader Feishu streaming repairs.

options.title: Repair, Rebase, Then Require Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, resolve the dirty branch, and require redacted live Feishu/CardKit proof before merge.

options.title: Maintainer Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer with Feishu access can validate the repaired branch in a real tenant and apply a proof override if the live behavior matches the expected accumulation.

options.title: Fold Into Broad Tracker
options.body: Pause or close this PR later if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability work.

recommendation.title: Repair, Rebase, Then Require Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, resolve the dirty branch, and require redacted live Feishu/CardKit proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This login is the current PR assignee and has recent history in Feishu streaming-card final delivery and closeout behavior.
